content.hookText: 7 things i wish i knew before opening my medspa

slides.body: they book consultations then disappear. having ai follow up automatically saved my sanity and booking rate.

slides.headline: 2. consent forms kill your flow
slides.body: spending 10 minutes on paperwork between every patient adds hours to your day. automate what you can.

slides.headline: 3. nervous patients need extra nurturing
slides.body: first-time botox patients spiral with anxiety. automated check-ins and educational content build trust before they even arrive.

slides.headline: 4. empty treatment rooms = lost money
slides.body: every cancelled appointment that sits empty is $300+ gone. you need systems to fill those gaps instantly.
